correctness.rationale: At most q perpendicular hyperplanes cannot cover the ambient vector space, giving the lower bound q+1. In odd characteristic an anisotropic two-plane yields q+1 projective directions paired by orthogonal complement. In even characteristic a radical plane gives total domination and a nondegenerate plane plus one vector in its orthogonal complement gives the q+2 paired witness. Independent enumeration reproduced 3/4, 3/4 and 4/4 for (q,n)=(2,3),(2,4),(3,3).
